# AIM — AI Infrastructure & Machines — Agency Profile
> Technology engineering agency. Your Engineering Team, On Demand.

## Organization
Name: AIM — AI Infrastructure & Machines
Legal name: AI Infrastructure & Machines
Also known as: AIM, AIM System, AIM Systems, AIM Studio
Registration: Udyam-registered MSME (India)
Location: Madhya Pradesh, India; clients in India, the UK and Europe
Websites: https://aimsystem.in/ · https://aimstudio.co.in/
Client Partner & Technical Lead: Ankit Panicker — works with clients to understand requirements, shape technical direction and coordinate engineering delivery.

## Positioning
From one senior engineer to a complete product team, AIM designs, builds, deploys and operates production-grade software, AI systems, automation and cloud infrastructure.

## Services
- Product Engineering: SaaS, web applications, APIs, backend systems, internal platforms, enterprise applications, product modernization.
- AI Engineering: LLM applications, AI agents, RAG, AI automation, voice AI, STT/TTS, AI orchestration, model integrations.
- Platform Engineering: cloud, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, observability, distributed systems, reliability engineering.
- Automation & Integrations: API and CRM integrations, WhatsApp, telephony, workflow and business process automation, data pipelines.

## Engagement models
One Engineer · Specialist · Engineering Pod · Complete Product Team. Start with the capacity you need and expand as the project grows.
How we work: Discover → Architect → Assemble → Build → Deploy → Operate.
Client ownership: client cloud, client API accounts, client-controlled credentials, documented deployment, source ownership, transferable infrastructure.

## Engineering principles
API first · observable · reliable (retries, idempotency, queues, controlled failure handling) · secure · scalable · maintainable.
Security & reliability practices: authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, encryption, TLS, scoped access, secrets management, audit logging, rate limiting, monitoring, backup, recovery, observability.

## Technology
Python, FastAPI, Node.js, TypeScript, React, Next.js; PostgreSQL, Redis, Firestore; Azure, AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Nginx, Cloudflare; Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry; LLMs, RAG, Whisper, Deepgram, XTTS, Kokoro; Twilio, Telnyx, Vapi, SIP, WhatsApp Business API.

## Platforms
- APEX Connect: AI-powered customer engagement infrastructure — multi-tenant architecture, voice infrastructure, messaging, AI orchestration, background workers, queues, retry handling, rate limits, spend controls, observability, provider integrations. Architecture: Tenant → API → Queue → Supervisor → AI → Communication → Analytics. Usage-based pricing.
- AIM Remote AI: AI operating layer connecting phone, desktop and voice to your machine; local or cloud models.
- Healthcare Operations Platform: hospital workflows, patient operations and clinical administration — in development.
- R&D: Shortz media pipeline, Apex Core deterministic automation, Free Tools.

## Selected engineering work
- Healthcare — AI-Powered Patient Communication (Apple Hospital; production): multi-tenant communication platform for automated patient outreach across voice and WhatsApp, with campaign management, scheduling and outcome tracking. Engineering: campaign orchestration, queue-based workers, retry scheduling, per-tenant capacity controls, provider integrations, outcome tracking, automated reporting. Stack: APEX Connect, Python, Redis, PostgreSQL, telephony, STT, LLM, TTS, WhatsApp Business API. Campaign flow: List → Call → Retry → WhatsApp → Report. Outcome: 15K+ calls processed, 6.8K+ answered, ~45% connected/answered.
- Education — Multi-Tenant Institutional Communication (BIMTS College; production): dedicated environment for voice outreach and WhatsApp automation with isolated tenant operations. Engineering: isolated tenant architecture, campaign automation, independent tenant configuration, billing separation, outreach tracking.
- Hospitality — Digital Experience Engineering (Café Ciel at The OWO, London; delivered): complete digital experience covering implementation, iterative revisions, deployment and technical delivery on a compressed timeline. Delivery: Design → Implementation → Revisions → Deployment. Delivered on schedule. Testimonial (Vedika, Café Ciel): "Ankit independently delivered a production digital experience for Café Ciel at The OWO, London, within a highly compressed timeline… We would confidently recommend him for future technical engagements."

## Workloads
High-volume communication (campaign orchestration, queues, retries, capacity controls) · multi-tenant platforms (tenant isolation, independent configuration) · AI-powered systems (STT → LLM → TTS pipelines, provider integrations, orchestration) · digital experiences (rapid implementation, iterative development, production deployment) · institutional systems.
Delivery process for an engagement: Understand → Architect → Build → Integrate → Deploy → Operate.
